title: Replace blocked V21 qualification transaction with reuse-aware trusted evidence
goal: Replace BLOCKED PR #90 with an ordered two-step Stage A authority: first make the trusted qualification harness explicitly reuse-aware without claiming a fresh native reopen, then produce a fresh coding-agent product candidate with strict state serialization, non-destructive staged recovery, net48 compatibility evidence, and complete deterministic state/retry/provenance coverage. This task remains qualification-only and must not implement or infer any Valve/Stage-B contract facts.

blockedFindings: The strict deserializer rejected the serializer's own JSON object envelope and could not round-trip state.

executionPlan.ordering: The protected trusted-harness refinement must be independently reviewed, merged, and green on trusted main before the fresh product candidate starts. The task-authority PR itself implements neither stage.

stages.title: Make trusted second-run evidence explicitly reuse-aware
stages.author: primary-chatgpt
requirements: Change only the two exact allowed paths; do not modify any other workflow, agent, task, runner configuration, product source, vendor payload, or IndustrialMDE.
Keep the workflow trusted-main-only. It must not check out or execute unmerged candidate code on Windows/TIA.

Run 1 must truthfully represent its actual mode. For the first valid TXN-002 qualification it is fresh: exit 0, success=true, isReuse=false, nativeReopenSuccess=true. On a later trusted rerun it may itself be reuse: exit 0, success=true, isReuse=true, nativeReopenSuccess=false. In either mode identities match and originalProvenanceRunId plus exact UTC originalCompletedAtUtc are non-empty.

A successful second run must be explicit reuse: exit 0, success=true, isReuse=true, nativeReopenSuccess=false, no fresh migration/reopen claim, matching source/build/qualification/archive identities, and the same immutable originalProvenanceRunId/originalCompletedAtUtc as run 1.
The second-run gate must fail closed when reuse/provenance fields are missing, null, malformed, non-UTC, changed, or inconsistent with run 1.

Public evidence may expose only bounded sanitized identities, hashes, reuse state, and immutable provenance; no absolute paths, usernames, vendor payload contents, or arbitrary Siemens exception text.
Add the smallest deterministic Python regression that validates fresh-run1 -> reuse-run2 and reuse-run1 -> repeated-reuse-run2 contracts, and rejects the old run2.nativeReopenSuccess=true-only gate.
completionGate: Fresh isolated chatgpt-secondary exact-SHA review is APPROVE.
Primary performs delegated merge only after both gates pass.
Post-merge CI on trusted main is green before Stage 2 begins.

stages.title: Implement the qualification transaction on a new agent branch
stages.author: coding-agent
dependsOn: trusted-harness-refinement is independently approved and merged
trusted main contains the reuse-aware harness and green post-merge CI
requirements: Start a fresh agent branch from the then-current trusted main; do not repair, update, merge, or cherry-pick PR #90.

Preserve exactly GlobalLibraries.RetrieveWithUpgrade(source .zal19, target directory, OpenMode.ReadWrite) -> Save -> compressed .zal21 Archive -> close -> current-version GlobalLibraries.Retrieve verification.
Use a new versioned qualification recipe identity for TXN-002 so no superseded PR #90 state/artifact can qualify for reuse.

On a fresh successful invocation, publish isReuse=false, nativeReopenSuccess=true, and non-empty originalProvenanceRunId/originalCompletedAtUtc only after archive hashing and actual current-version Retrieve verification succeed.

On a reuse invocation, perform no fresh migration or current-version Retrieve, publish isReuse=true and nativeReopenSuccess=false, and preserve the exact originalProvenanceRunId/originalCompletedAtUtc from the first verified success.

Reuse requires an exact match of schema version, qualification identity, source archive SHA-256, TIA build identity, qualification recipe identity, native archive SHA-256, completed-success state, and immutable verification provenance.
A completed-success record must explicitly encode successful native reopen verification; a completed-shaped record with missing/false verification is stored false-success and must be rejected.

Serializer and deserializer must strictly round-trip every state the implementation itself emits, including in-progress and completed-success records. JSON object delimiters are structural, not fields.

Strict parsing rejects malformed JSON, unknown or duplicate fields, invalid enum/schema values, invalid or non-UTC timestamps, and null/missing values where the specific state requires a value; state-specific optional fields must remain round-trippable.

Do not depend on implicit usings or APIs unavailable to .NET Framework 4.8. Add deterministic net48 compile evidence for the Siemens-independent qualification-state helper while preserving normal net10 test execution.

Use attempt-local staging and non-destructive publication. A failed/interrupted attempt must not delete or rewrite any valid completed-success record, archive, manifest, or immutable provenance, including a valid record for another identity.

Do not use delete-then-move replacement for completed evidence. Unverified/corrupt/incomplete artifacts may be quarantined or retired only through a deterministic decision that first proves they are not a valid completed-success identity.
Recovery from interrupted temporary publication must never promote an unvalidated temp record and must permit a truthful retry without falsely reusing an archive.
Keep arbitrary exception text, absolute paths, usernames, and vendor payload content out of public diagnostics.
QualificationStateTests.cs is mandatory and must directly exercise the helper rather than merely linking it into the test assembly.

scope: This task is Stage A qualification transaction/reuse/provenance only. Do not implement ValveProfileProbe, ValveProfileContract, Valve call/reference generation, dependency discovery, target CPU materialization, DB ownership, memory addressing, or any other Stage-B behavior.
Do not guess Siemens migration APIs, Valve interfaces, dependencies, versions, ownership, DB, memory, target, or reference-project facts.
Vendor archives/projects stay private and outside GitHub. No vendor payload path or content becomes public evidence.
No runner installation/configuration, secret, AllowList bootstrap, workflow other than the exact Stage-1 workflow, or IndustrialMDE change is authorized.
PR #90 remains unchanged and unmerged. This task creates a replacement route, not repair 3/2.
Windows/TIA executes only trusted merged main after the applicable independently reviewed merge.

requirements: The two ordered stages remain separate PRs with separate exact-SHA CI and independent review; Stage 2 cannot start before Stage 1 is trusted on main.
Stage-1 changed paths are exactly its two listed paths; Stage-2 candidate changes are exactly candidatePolicy.allowedPaths.

The trusted two-run harness distinguishes fresh reopen from reuse, accepts both fresh-run1 -> reuse-run2 and later reuse-run1 -> repeated-reuse-run2, and validates immutable original successful verification provenance without requiring or claiming a fresh run-2 reopen.
The qualify-library CLI remains compatible and the documented RetrieveWithUpgrade -> Save -> Archive -> current-version Retrieve sequence is behaviorally preserved.
A completed-success record cannot become visible before native archive hashing and actual current-version Retrieve verification succeed.
Fresh success and reuse have explicit truthful result semantics: fresh isReuse=false/nativeReopenSuccess=true; reuse isReuse=true/nativeReopenSuccess=false with unchanged original provenance.
Strict state serialization/deserialization round-trips all emitted states and fails closed on malformed, duplicate, unknown, null-invalid, schema-invalid, and timestamp-invalid input.
Publication/recovery is staged and non-destructive; failed retries and mismatches do not destroy valid completed evidence or immutable provenance.

Deterministic tests cover at least fresh completed-success, repeated reuse, provenance preservation, incomplete/in-progress state, corrupt/malformed state, stored false-success, archive/source/build/recipe/identity mismatch, invalid schema/timestamp/null/duplicate/unknown fields, interrupted temp publication, retry, and preservation of unrelated valid completed evidence.
The Siemens-independent helper has explicit net48 compile evidence and normal net10 tests; full TiaV21Worker net48 build is proven only on trusted merged main with installed V21 assemblies.
Existing SiemensBackend tests and Motor generation stay green.
No Valve/Stage-B facts or behavior, vendor payloads, runner configuration, unmerged Windows/TIA execution, or IndustrialMDE changes are introduced.
